title: factory-dev-slot env profile
description: Extra container setup a company network needs. Shipped as profiles/<name>.json by an installed skill and named by adapters.envProfile. Every list is optional.

host.description: Host path; a leading ~ is the home directory.

warnIfMissing.description: Logged when the host path is absent; the mount is skipped.

envFromFile.description: A secret read from the first line of a file that starts with linePrefix. It reaches the container through the child process env, never argv or logs.

passEnv.description: Host env vars forwarded as they are when set.

rewriteLoopbackEnv.description: Host env vars forwarded with 127.0.0.1 or localhost replaced by host.docker.internal (proxy URLs).

caBundle.description: Extra CA certificates, mounted read-only and pointed to by `env` (default NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS).

keychains.description: For macos-keychain: keychain files to export.

path.description: For file: a PEM bundle on the host.

buildFailed.description: Appended to the message when docker build fails (e.g. which login to run).
